Round 2
How a match works
1

Two teams on stage, one blackboard each. All three members solve together on the team's board.

2

Pick a number and the integral appears. You get 5 seconds to read it, then 2 minutes on the clock.

3

Raise your hand the moment you finish. We tick your team and your time is recorded.

4

First to finish with the correct answer goes through.

5

If the first team is wrong, the other team goes through with a correct answer, even if it finished later.

6

If neither team is correct, the judge either plays a tie-breaker integral or no team advances.

Knockout
The road to Grand Integrator

Six rounds. Every match is one-on-one: win and you go through. The semi-final winners play the Final for ranks 1 and 2 and the other two play the third-place match. Each round has its own set of integrals and they get tougher as you go.
